description: Frontend: host binds users to restored teams in the restore workflow and lobby; join page auto-places a bound user in their team with an editable (new) team name; picker hides reserved teams; retention UI/redirect never appears for restored rooms. Consumes the API from FEAT-001/002 (see ../../plan.md D3-D7). Read frontend/AGENTS.md and the relevant node_modules/next/dist/docs guide before writing Next.js code.
steps: types/restore.ts, services/restore.service.ts (searchUsers, bind, bindings in create payload), services/room.service.ts (join with optional restoredTeamId plus teamName), types/backend.ts: new fields reserved, reservedForYou, originalName, reservedLabel.

components/restore/RestoreWorkflow.tsx: per-team Manager control with user search (username/display name), clear button, duplicate prevention, host team shown as You; send bindings on create; note to bind before sharing the code.

app/join/page.tsx: reservedForYou -> 'Your team: <original name>' with editable team name prefilled, no picker; otherwise picker lists only unreserved unclaimed teams, reserved ones disabled. RestoreLobbyPanel.tsx: show 'was <originalName>' and reserved label; host bind/unbind control.

app/room/[roomCode]/page.tsx: retentionEnabled && !restore; no redirect to /retention when snapshot.restore; guard the retention route page for restored rooms. RestorePoolPanel.tsx: copy says newly added database players are included (no NEW badge).
frontend/tests/restore-ui.mjs: cover workflow binding search + payload, join as reserved user with a new name, picker hides reserved teams, no retention UI in a restored lobby.
UTF-8 strict-decode scan of every changed file in backend and frontend.
acceptance_criteria: Host can pick a registered user for each non-host team before creating the room and sees the choice in the lobby
A reserved user sees their team and can join under a different name without choosing from a picker
Retention screens and gating never appear for restored rooms
Typecheck, next build and restore-ui pass; no non-UTF-8 bytes in changed files
verification: cd frontend; run tests/restore-ui.mjs with the existing runner (see package.json and tests/ui-harness.mjs); auction-ui, overview-ui, retention-ui, retention-overlay-ui and formations-ui already failed on clean HEAD
